timeline.event: Moved to Silicon Valley, started Zip2 with brother Kimbal
Compaq acquired Zip2 for $307M. Co-founded X.com (online banking)
X.com merged with Confinity to form PayPal
eBay acquired PayPal for $1.5B. Founded SpaceX
Co-founded Tesla Motors (with Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning)
Led Tesla's Series A funding round, became chairman
Co-founded SolarCity with cousins. SpaceX Falcon 1 first launch (failed)
Became Tesla CEO. SpaceX Falcon 1 first successful orbital flight. Tesla Roadster launched
Tesla IPO on NASDAQ. Started tweeting actively
Tesla Model S launched. SpaceX Dragon first commercial resupply to ISS
Proposed Hyperloop concept
Tesla Model X launched. Co-founded OpenAI
Founded Neuralink and The Boring Company. Tesla acquired SolarCity
Tesla Model 3 launched. SpaceX reused a Falcon 9 rocket for first time
'Funding secured' tweet controversy. Launched Tesla into space on Falcon Heavy. Departed OpenAI board
Neuralink demo. Tesla Cybertruck unveiled. Starlink satellites began launching
Tesla Model Y. Defied COVID lockdowns. Tesla stock surged. Became 2nd richest person
Became world's richest person. Tesla accepted then rejected Bitcoin. SNL hosting. TIME Person of the Year
Acquired Twitter for $44B. Rebranded to X. Massive layoffs. Political shift rightward
Founded xAI. Launched Grok chatbot. Twitter/X controversies. Starship first flight
Neuralink first human implant. Endorsed Trump. Major political engagement. Tesla robotaxi unveil
Brief role as government advisor (DOGE). Continued xAI development. Starship progress
